verdict.rationale: Warp ships automations: cloud agents run from triggers and schedules. The only nod toward versioning is a single marketing line about "factories as code", which implies automation definitions live as code. Review evidence covers runs, not definitions: users can open run transcripts and share them, and every run is "tracked, auditable". Missing for 10: explicit versioning or change history for automation/trigger/schedule definitions, review or approval of changes to automation definitions, any rollback to a prior automation version, and independent corroboration.
